reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI theme plugin that applies an Arcaea-inspired high-key prismatic visual design using CSS, inline SVG, colors, layout styling, and bundled fonts without replacing chat components or making network requests.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供一套受 Arcaea 启发的高亮棱彩视觉主题，包含 CSS、内联 SVG、配色、布局样式和字体定制。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI theme that provides an Arcaea-inspired high-key prismatic appearance with custom CSS, inline SVG, colors, layout styling, and bundled fonts.

capabilities: Applies a visual theme to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Bundles and embeds font assets and inline SVG/CSS styling
Changes the selected theme preference while enabled
